label: Image
intent: The picture is reframed to a new crop. Light: the landscape swipes left inside the fixed frame, its left hill sliding out past the edge, overshoots the new crop a little and snaps back into it; the sun is farther away and follows the hills a beat later, so the scene has depth. Strong: a faster, longer swipe that overshoots further and settles in two beats, with the sun trailing further behind. The frame never moves and the new crop holds.

hills.//: v1's hills and their cropped end pose: the same command list, so the crop slides with the pan and the left slope stays clipped at the frame

image.//: v1 Solid: the frame as a filled band with the picture window open, one bridged subpath

pan.//: 1 = v1's new crop, 2.4 to the left; past 1 the crop slides on along the same slope
